detail.title: WAKE Proposal 93: Maintaining Continuity and Managing Project Capacity
detail.summary: This proposal continues WAKE's operations under Attention enforcement. Based on the proposal constraints, capacity blocks require parking an active project or maintaining parked status for selected-topic projects. We update the project status for Autonomous Objective Discovery Pathways while adhering to strict governance constraints, ensuring process persistence and rigorous methodological alignment.
